_comment: Validated P-017 golf pod parameters. UPDATED 2026-07-20: extended from 10 to 12 tournaments by folding in THOC26 + COPC26, whose settlement was unpopulated on the original pull date and is now populated. The original 10-event Leg A result reproduced BIT-EXACT from a fresh data pull, so the harness is verified faithful. edge_bump values remain the CONSERVATIVE lower-CI convention (matching qualifier_favorite_pod P-015), NOT point estimates. Full detail + audit trail in backtest/REPORT_Golf_TopN_2026-07.md (EXTENSION section); raw numbers in backtest_results_extended.json. Regenerate after each new event via re-pull + backtest.

_previous_10_event_values.note: Kept for audit. Leg A barely moved; Leg B degraded materially - see below.

leg_A_pre_tourn_taker._ask_band_note: The SHIPPED pod and config use ask_cap 0.45 (golf_topn_pod.py, config_multi_pod.yaml); the canonical backtest run uses 0.40. That mismatch is now RESOLVED in the pod's favour: on 12 events the 0.08-0.45 band returns +0.0714 CI [+0.0430,+0.0990] (n=1149), slightly better than 0.08-0.40 and also excluding zero. No config change needed. Follow-up: align backtest_golf.py's canonical band to 0.45 (or parameterise it) so future re-runs report the band the pod actually trades.
leg_A_pre_tourn_taker.notes: Estimate essentially unchanged (+6.81c -> +6.92c); CI narrowed 7.12c -> 6.13c, which is roughly the mechanical gain from two more clusters. This is CONFIRMATION, not new information, and does NOT satisfy the ~8-live-tournament go/no-go gate (that gate is about live paper fills). top-20 (+9.15c [+4.68,+13.41]) stronger than top-10 (+4.04c [+1.57,+6.46]); band-robust +6.62..+7.19c across 5 bands. edge_bump 0.04 remains comfortably conservative. Exclude signature-event weeks initially (TRAV26 exception). result='scalar' (competitor withdrew) VERIFIED not to affect this leg: of 134 scalar records, zero clear the entry gate.

leg_B_fade_maker._status_change: Was PROMISING_UNDERPOWERED at +9.1c on 4 events. On 6 events the CI now straddles zero. Do NOT treat +9.1c as a live expectation.
leg_B_fade_maker._KNOWN_BUG: backtest_golf.py leg_fade_maker mislabels its output: line 318 appends one per_bet entry per through-print FILL EVENT regardless of contract count, and line 355 OVERWRITES the correctly contract-weighted mean computed at line 332 with that unweighted fill-event mean. The 'as_coded' figures above preserve the original methodology for apples-to-apples comparison; 'contract_weighted' is the correct per-contract number. Fixing this is a recommended follow-up.
leg_B_fade_maker.notes: Degradation investigated before reporting: not a settlement artifact (Leg A is positive on both new events using the same settlement data); COPC26 is genuinely illiquid (7.6 trades/market vs 67-207 elsewhere) but carries only 6% of contracts, so most of the drop comes from THOC26, a major with the most trade data in the sample. Leg B also does not reproduce bit-exactly (+8.62c vs +9.15c on the same 4 events) - the trades endpoint is unstable under re-pagination, so treat Leg B as +/-0.5c. Contract-weighted +3.3c is BELOW the +4.55c maker half-baseline. Window timing finding stands: 48-24h is negative; edge is Sat->Sun-AM. Keep paper-only; collect live fills.

leg_C_makecut.notes: NOT re-run in the 2026-07-20 extension (KXPGAMAKECUT not re-pulled - rate limits). Original verdict stands: only 12 two-sided pre-tournament quotes in sample. Revisit after live paper collection.

rejected.top5: NOT re-run in the 2026-07-20 extension (only 1051/1677 markets re-pulled; a partial pull is a biased subset because jobs are event-ordered, so it must not be quoted). Original verdict stands: net +0.5c, CI [-0.7,+1.8] straddles zero. Do not trade.
rejected.top40: NOT re-run (not re-pulled). Original verdict stands: only 1 event with data - insufficient.
rejected.outright_winner: efficient + maker fees + institutional MM (0.2c spreads). Benchmark only, per GOLF_KALSHI_RESEARCH.md.

_data_provenance.reproduction_check: 10-event Leg A reproduced to 4dp: n=926, +0.0681, CI [+0.0306,+0.1018]
_data_provenance.kalshi_rate_limit_note: Kalshi throttles by CONCURRENCY, not aggregate rate. 12 threads -> constant 429s; a single connection at 0.15s interval -> zero 429s. Use sequential pulls.
_data_provenance.data_files: golf_research/candles.jsonl + trades.jsonl (gitignored by *.jsonl; regenerate settled_markets.json via collect_settled.py before re-pulling)
